title: The Mughal Custodians and Bahadur Shah’s Death

blocks.text: This page continues the catalog of Mughal custodians and local officers broken by Sikh pressure across Tarawari, Kunjpura, Samana, Sadhaura, and the surrounding tract. The emphasis falls on the custodians of Tarawari and other officials whose losses are repeated before the throne as evidence of spreading disorder.

At the same time the political center shifts. Petitioners before the emperor report that Banda has opened passage for the moment, yet relief comes too late because Bahadur Shah died on the road before he could stabilize the north himself.
The succession immediately changes the stakes. Farrukhsiyar on the throne inherits not peace but a court already primed by slanderers to resume the campaign against Banda.
